content: Stripe webhook signature verification fails most often from: verifying against a parsed/re-serialized JSON body instead of the raw request bytes (must use raw body middleware, e.g. express.raw for the webhook route only, not express.json globally); mixing up test-mode vs live-mode signing secrets across environments; and skipping verification entirely, which lets any POST to the webhook URL be treated as a real Stripe event. Best practice: call stripe.webhooks.constructEvent with raw body + Stripe-Signature header + endpoint secret, store processed event.id for idempotency, and return 2xx fast before slow business logic.
